title: uncomment configuration
description: Configuration for uncomment, read from `.uncomment.toml`. Every key is optional: a config file states only what it overrides, and a key it omits is inherited from the next config outward or the built-in default. Unknown keys are rejected.

languages.description: Per-language overrides. The table key is arbitrary; the `name` field selects the grammar, as a built-in name or a tree-sitter-language-pack name.

patterns.description: Settings applied to the files matching a path glob. `*` does not cross `/` and `**` does; the glob is anchored at the directory holding this config file, and the last matching key wins.

global.title: Global settings
global.description: Settings applied to every file a run collects.

remove_docs.description: Remove documentation comments, including Python docstrings.

preserve_patterns.description: Extra substrings that mark a comment as preserved. Matched as a case-sensitive substring, not a regular expression, anywhere in the comment.

exclude.description: Path globs no subcommand collects a file from. Anchored at the directory holding this config file.

use_default_ignores.description: Preserve the built-in linting directives (eslint-disable, noqa, @ts-ignore, and the rest). Setting this to false drops the whole set.

respect_gitignore.description: Skip paths matched by a .gitignore file.

traverse_git_repos.description: Descend into nested git repositories rather than stopping at their root.

language.title: Language override
language.description: An override of a built-in language, or the registration of any other compiled-in grammar. The section must claim at least one file, through `extensions` or `filenames`, and must name at least one `comment_nodes` kind.

name.description: The grammar to use, as a built-in name or a tree-sitter-language-pack name. Looked up lowercased; a name matching neither is reported and the section is inert.

extensions.description: File extensions this language claims. A leading dot is optional.

filenames.description: Whole filenames this language claims, matched case-sensitively before any extension rule. An entry ending in `.*` claims every name starting with the part before the `*`; the only way to reach an extensionless file such as `BUILD`.

comment_nodes.description: tree-sitter node kinds that are comments — `line_comment`, `block_comment`, `comment`. These are node kinds from the grammar, not literal delimiters.

doc_comment_nodes.description: tree-sitter node kinds that are documentation comments. Python records a docstring as `string`.

preserve_patterns.description: Extra preserved substrings for this language.

remove_todos.description: Override the global `remove_todos` for this language.

remove_fixme.description: Override the global `remove_fixme` for this language.

remove_docs.description: Override the global `remove_docs` for this language.

use_default_ignores.description: Override the global `use_default_ignores` for this language.

pattern.title: Pattern settings
pattern.description: Settings applied to the files matching `[patterns."<glob>"]`.

preserve_patterns.description: Omit the key to inherit the patterns in force, set `[]` to clear them, or list patterns to extend them.

lint.title: Lint settings
lint.description: Tag linting for `uncomment lint`. Inert until `enabled` is true. A nested `[lint]` amends the table above it key by key rather than replacing it.

tags.description: Tag words to look for. Defaults to TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX.

canonical_tag.description: The tag `--fix` normalizes to. Defaults to TODO and must be one of `tags`.

case_sensitive_tags.description: Match tags case-sensitively. A miscased tag is reported as `tag-not-canonical` when this is false.

key_pattern.description: Regular expression that extracts an issue key from a comment's text. Prefer a named `key` capture group; the first group is the fallback.

current_issue_from_branch.description: Regular expression that extracts the key of the issue the current branch works on. Its first group is the key.

include_doc_comments.description: Also lint documentation comments and docstrings, which are out of scope by default.

severity.title: Rule severity
severity.description: `error` fails the run, `warn` reports without failing it, and `off` skips the rule entirely.
